data.long_meaning: In Old Germanic, Griselda translates to 'gracious' or 'kind' 'battle-maiden'. It was a common name for women in medieval literature, particularly for older women with strong character and endurance. The name Grissel carries the meaning “Griselda, old woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grissel usually hope their child will grow to embody griselda, old woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
